**Finding: Deviation (§ 22.1)** — submitted.

- **Issue:** § 22.1 allowed audits "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — squarely the playbook walk-away position.
- **Mitigating context:** § 22.2 already sets Vendor-borne costs with a 5% underpayment flip (matches preferred) and bars direct system access, so § 22.1 was also internally inconsistent.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** one audit per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where feasible, independent auditor under confidentiality, no direct or remote system access; audit satisfiable by producing records. Fallback of 15 days' notice flagged in the comment.
